tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get ClaraConverts pricing: the free 30-day trial (no card, every Pro feature) and the paid plans (Standard, Pro, Volume) in USD/month.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List the CRM, booking, commerce, payments, and other integrations ClaraConverts can connect to.

tools.name: create_trial_tenant
tools.description: Create a free, no-card ClaraConverts trial for a website, with every Pro feature (voice conversations included). tools.name: get_embed_snippet
tools.description: Get the <script> embed snippet for your trial tenant. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.

tools.name: get_tenant_settings

tools.name: update_tenant_settings
tools.description: Update your trial tenant's persona and widget settings (name, goal, branding, position, lead notification email). Only the fields you pass are changed. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.
